description: Separate agreed task completion from business outcomes, and independent review rounds from ordinary checks.
setup: Create an isolated mind-forge projects/demo with the candidate lbkit, bin/lb and mf-cli available.
Materialize common_files and the selected variant Logbook; index and resolve Article/Prompt/Thinking before launch.
Keep grading assertions outside the subject workspace. No external services or actual business execution.

common_files.AGENTS.md:
# Fictional workspace
Use requested lb-* skills under .lbkit/skills and their linked contracts. Only this workspace is authorized. Use actual local mf and bin/lb. No network, dependency install, commit, publish, cleanup, business execution or extra agents. All data is fictional public material. documents.adapter is mind-forge. Read docs/document-guide.md and the mf-cli reference under .agents/skills/mf-cli.
Local configuration tools supply a file digest, target path, exit status and owner readback, not pipeline run/config IDs or task graphs. No independent reviewer, extra repository, PR or deployment environment is required unless the current plan explicitly requests one. Formatting preferences are local presentation choices.
common_files.docs/document-guide.md:
# Document guide
Logbook: projects/demo/docs/log.md; its Prompt: projects/demo/prompts/log.md; Thinking: projects/demo/thinking/log.md.
Resolve with mf -p projects/demo article show docs/log.md --json; index with mf -p projects/demo article index --json. Supported Logbook writes use bin/lb, current context token and preview. Authorized Thinking updates may use local edits. Preserve human content. Business returns are records/returns.json; no new archive or delivery binding is required for these status facts.
